clips.title: The story
paras: "Sea Wolf" MacKinley has retrieved the foot of his late debtor Maury, only to find that what he is owed is locked inside it. To claim what is owed, he directs travelers to the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound in Stranglethorn Vale to search for the missing key.

Following the retrieval of Maury's foot in Voodoo Dues, "Sea Wolf" MacKinley faces an unexpected complication in Booty Bay. The late debtor put a lock on his foot, and the valuables he owes are sealed inside.

Maury liked to gamble with the ogres of the Mosh'Ogg mound, off to the northeast. MacKinley remembers Maury saying the ogres drove him away once he had won too much, so he suspects they now hold the key and sends travelers to look for it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Curses! That swab Maury put a lock on his foot, and I can't open it! His loot's inside the foot, and that's what he owes me!

We need to find the key to open the lock. Maury was known to gamble with the Mosh'Ogg ogres, at their mound to the northeast. And he told me, when he was still alive, that the last time he went to the mound he was chased off after winning too much. Maybe the Ogres there have his key.
But if they do, you might have to kill a load of them to find the right one...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ahoy, friend! Have you yet found Maury's Key?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found it! Thanks a million, friend. You've been a big help to me!
Here you go - you earned this!
